summary: Injured solo hiker stranded without food or water at Crater Lake (10,075 ft), base of Maroon Bells; Zoleo SOS 8:38 p.m.; 10 Mountain Rescue Aspen volunteers reached the hiker 10:42 p.m. and walked them out to Maroon Bells day-use parking by 1:13 a.m. July 18.
notes: The Next Summit article published 2023-07-19, citing the Pitkin County Sheriff's Office / Mountain Rescue Aspen joint statement; 'Monday' = 2023-07-17 (Monday-verified). Run 1019 chunk B (Pitkin SO news alerts angle; no PCSO newsflash URL surfaced for this release).
